supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account ext.rwong was created at 13:43:56 UTC by sara.ali.
The creation event uses the same logon ID as sara.ali's successful network logon to DC-COP-01 from WS-SALI-01 shortly beforehand.
ext.rwong was added to the Contractors group, matching the stated help-desk practice for temporary ext.* accounts.
The available evidence is consistent with an authorized help-desk account-creation workflow; it does not show that ext.rwong received administrator rights.

The supplied time window does not establish whether ext.rwong later authenticated or what activity the account performed.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation was backed by a valid request and was intended for the person named in the account.
